qualityReviewMethod: Independent reviewer blinded to variant; verify six fields against controlling source locators; record missing/false claims and actionable plan quality. Include reviewer quota separately.

treatments.A: Task + common authority packet; native exploration, no Badger output.
treatments.B: Same common packet + one pinned bounded topology; native tools remain available.
treatments.C: B topology compressed once by separately costed Chat/control plane; preserve source locators, uncertainty and omitted material; coding agent receives compact packet.
treatments.D: Only after recorded A/B/C quality-adjusted results justify it: bounded composite of Badger + Nx + SpecOps/catalog + Git/issue projections; no authority promotion.
